change: FOLLOW-1311 slice 6 (template clean-up for external claims): the description SYSTEM prompt no longer lists area, market and demand descriptors as allowed without the listing and no longer tells the model to express a theme the facts do not support; 16 headline personas (ARCHETYPE_GUIDANCE) ask for their themes only as the listing states them. v26 is a prompt-digest re-freeze of v25: every byte is v25's except prompt_sha256.description_system of every case, prompt_sha256.headline_user of the cases under refrozen, and prompt_sha256.description_user of the case under voice_fallback_refrozen (an empty VOICE section falls back to the persona; no shipped template has one). No verdict, headline, violation or stamp moved. Each input.copy_template stays as frozen, so the playbook edits of the same slice do not reach this corpus: they are pinned by copy-template-external-claims.follow1311.test.ts.
recorded_outputs_predate_prompt: Every raw output in this corpus was produced by an older prompt. They are replayed through the unchanged checks, so they pin the checks and the new prompt bytes, NOT what the new prompt makes the model write.

yield_hunter.from: Focus on ROI numbers: gross yield %, estimated annual rental income, cap rate, void risk mitigation, and price-per-sqm vs local average. Mention transport links only when they affect rental demand.
yield_hunter.to: Focus on ROI numbers: gross yield %, annual rental income, cap rate and void risk, only as the listing states them. Mention transport links only as the listing states them.

system_prompt_change.from: Write as an experienced human copywriter who knows this market — not as an AI.
system_prompt_change.to: Write as an experienced human copywriter — not as an AI.

system_prompt_change.from: If the voice pattern asks you to lead with something the verified facts do not support with a number (e.g. "lead with cashflow" but no yield figure exists), lead with the theme using generic positive language — never with an invented figure.
system_prompt_change.to: If the voice pattern asks you to lead with something the verified facts do not support (e.g. "lead with cashflow" but no yield figure exists), lead with the verified facts that bear on it and leave the rest out — never with an invented figure or a claim the facts do not make.

system_prompt_change.from:

system_prompt_change.to:
